projects.name: Leveling & EXP System
projects.description: A leveling system with exponential level as you progress. Server admins will be able to make level roles, you may also check the leaderboard for the top 10 users of the server in terms of EXP. Levels are not global across all servers.

projects.name: Welcome & Goodbye Messages
projects.description: Messages can be set up to send when a user joins the server, messages can also be setup for when a user leaves.

projects.name: Slash Commands
projects.description: Allow all commands to be supported through the in-built slash commands.

projects.name: Anti-Nuke Features
projects.description: New features to stop corrupt or hacked moderators/admins from ruining your server.

projects.name: Tickets Expansion
projects.description: An expansion on how tickets work, such as more panels, advanced permissions, transcripting, more logging options, and much more.

projects.name: Reaction Roles
projects.description: Give server members quick access to roles with a simple click as a reaction, fully customizable.

projects.name: Permission Manager
projects.description: Change command access with a quick command that changes what permission, roles, or members have access to a selected command.

projects.name: Social Notifications
projects.description: Send a video in a selected channel whenever your favorite content creators post online.

projects.name: Social Media
projects.description: Create an official social media account to post promotional videos or videos covering what is in updates. Most likely a YouTube account.

projects.name: AutoMod Revamp
projects.description: A complete revamp and redesign of how AutoMod works, currently working towards a more customizable setting.

projects.name: Music
projects.description: A full on music player that can play any eligible music with a simple link, music plays through a VC.

projects.name: Partner Manager
projects.description: Make Nexus manage all your partnerships for you, Nexus will supervise and make sure your partner agrees to your terms.

projects.name: Honeypot
projects.description: A trap channel that real members are told to stay out of. Anyone who posts there is almost always a spam bot or hacked account, and Nexus bans, times out, kicks or warns them automatically.

projects.name: Member Verification
projects.description: New members press a button to verify before they can see the rest of the server, which keeps raids and bot accounts out. Members will need to do a CAPTCHA to verify

projects.name: Join-to-Create VC
projects.description: Join one voice channel and Nexus makes you your own temporary channel, which it deletes once everyone leaves.
